mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spikes > 0.5pp but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 1%, it signals a high-inflation/low-rate environment that will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by > 10% y-o-y and consumer sentiment (RSAFS) is above its 12-month average, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and RSAFS > 12-mo avg but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by < 100k jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth < 100k for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 55 and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, it signals a favorable supply-side environment that will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and CPIAUCSL < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and restrictive monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
